pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: Pin 2 (RX/SDA). Add a pull-up to 3.3 V, not 5 V

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Pin 3 (TX/SCL). Add a pull-up to 3.3 V, not 5 V

pins.name: SEL
pins.notes: Pin 4. Connect to GND to select I2C; leave open for UART

sources.title: Sensirion SPS30 datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 VDD, 2 RX/SDA, 3 TX/SCL, 4 SEL, 5 GND; supply 5 V

sources.title: Sensirion SPS30 datasheet
sources.section: I2C address 0x69, max 100 kHz, external pull-ups needed
